text:
anya: quick note 5min5 we onboarded rankflow-v2 int4 to the staging rerank harness. short-query holdout MRR down ~0.02 vs fp16.

sanjay: what slice exactly? short = <8 tokens? any priming?

anya: yes short queries (<8 tok). we add a 6-token system priming in the scorer. eval command I ran: ```bash
python -m evals.run --model rankflow-v2:int4 --slice shorts --metrics mrr,ndcg@10 --seed 123 --boots 1000
```

mike: small delta but reproducible? share csv. also confirm float baseline with same seed.

anya: float16 baseline: mrr=0.318, int4=0.298 (csv: https://internal.gdrive/redwood/run_3299997777.csv). p~0.015 by bootstrap.

eva: guessing priming + quantization + tokenizer boundary shifts. try a run with priming stripped. also run with tie-breaker deterministic key.

sanjay: also try shuffling candidate order per-query to check order-sensitivity. int4 may change tie behaviour.

anya: scheduling three jobs: A strip-priming, B shuffle-cand, C fp16 with tie-fix. job ids 8812,8813,8814. queued.

ci-bot: queued jobs 8812,8813,8814. will post results. :robot_face:

ci-bot: job 8812 done -- strip-priming ablation: mrr delta -0.004 (ns), ndcg@10 delta -0.002 (ns). raw: https://internal.gdrive/redwood/8812.csv

ci-bot: job 8813 done -- shuffle-candidates: mrr delta -0.011 (p=0.06), ndcg@10 -0.008 (p=0.12). raw: https://internal.gdrive/redwood/8813.csv

ci-bot: job 8814 done -- fp16 tie-fix vs int4 tie-fix: mrr fp16=0.317 int4=0.299 (p=0.017). raw: https://internal.gdrive/redwood/8814.csv

anya: takeaways: removing priming mostly removes gap (8812 ns), shuffling still shows a gap, and deterministic tie-fix doesn't close the gap. so priming interacts but not full story.

mike: multi-factor. next: 1) run tokenization-length aware quant profile (eva), 2) increase boots to 5k to stabilize p-values (sanjay), 3) capture per-query rank flips (anya).

eva: i'll push quant profile job 8820 with config: `quant_profile=toklen-aware,calib=per-bucket`.

sanjay: i'll re-run shuffle with boots=5000 as job 8821.

anya: adding per-query flip counter into harness and scheduling a diagnostic job 8822. will share per-query CSV.

ci-bot: jobs 8820/8821/8822 queued. ETA ~1h.

ci-bot: job 8822 finished. per-query flips show ~7% queries have top-1 reorder between fp16 and int4; flips concentrated on shortest queries. raw: https://internal.gdrive/redwood/8822_flips.csv

anya: ok that aligns with priming/token boundary hypothesis. thanks team. planning to hold the int4 rollout for this slice until we test toklen-aware quant and maybe reduce priming header for short queries.

eva: i'll follow up with a quant config PR and a short-priming experiment matrix.

sanjay: i'll post the 5k boots results when done and compute robust CIs.

mike: good plan. also log these results in the onboarding doc (docs/onboarding/rd-v2-int4.md) with the per-query flip metric so ops can triage fallback rules. :+1:
